gui.alaindustrial.reactor_controller.adv: Blocks around the racks turn to lava. Too many racks in one pile run away into an accident.
Running without a room
This pile is close to running away. Take a rack away or cut the redstone signal.
At the instability limit
Bring the reactor off the top of its scale and keep it there for a few seconds. Any of these works:
cut the redstone signal with the lever
take a rack away from the pile
feed water into the columns
Accident: countdown running
Without water nothing cools the reactor, and the heat rises all the way to an accident. Pipe water in through a Reactor Inlet before the heat reaches %1$s%%.
No water in the columns
The water cannot carry all the heat, and at %1$s%% the room starts to melt. Add another water line or lower the rod depth.
Running hot
The buffer is full and nothing takes the energy: connect a cable to a Reactor Outlet in the wall.
No fuel: put Fuel Rods into the Reactor Columns.
No redstone signal: give the controller a signal — a lever or a button by the door.
The rods are out: move the rod depth above 0%%.
The reaction is too weak to deliver a whole EU per tick: lower the rods deeper.
Reactor idle
Above %1$s%% heat the room melts its pipes and floor. Lower the rod depth or add water.
The water carries all the heat away, and the reactor stays cool.
All normal
The water carries only %1$s%% of the heat, and the rest keeps heating the reactor. Add another water line or lower the rod depth.
Not enough water
There is water, but the exhaust is blocked: check the Steam Pipes and the Steam Nozzle on top of the stack — a Fluid Pipe does not carry steam. The heat keeps rising.
Steam has nowhere to go
gui.alaindustrial.reactor_controller.che: A door, if any, reaches the floor
Controller in a wall, not an edge
gui.alaindustrial.reactor_controller.coo: Racks with no room around them boil nothing: they heat no water and need none. Seal a room around the columns to cool them with water.
Stack %1$s, %2$s is at full steam pressure, so its water cannot boil. Run a Steam Pipe from the top of the stack to a Steam Nozzle with air in front of its mouth — a Fluid Pipe does not carry steam.
Stack %1$s, %2$s is dry. Columns side by side share no water: pipe water into this stack, or check its line keeps up.
No stack holds any water, and nothing else cools a running reactor. Pipe water in through a Reactor Inlet.
Place Reactor Columns in the room and pipe water into them.
The loop is read once the room is sealed. The Room tab says what to fix.
Every stack has water and somewhere to send its steam.
The water carries only %1$s%% of the heat, and the rest stays in the core. Add another water line or lower the rod depth.
Seal the room to see its loop
gui.alaindustrial.reactor_controller.fix: A shell block is missing. Smoke rises from the hole.
Put the controller into a vertical wall — not a corner, floor or ceiling — facing out of the room.
The Reactor Airlock Door has to stand on the floor, two blocks tall.
The scan found no wall on one side: the shell has a hole, or the room is too big.
A room has one brain: remove the second controller.
Make the room smaller along its long side.
Too much of the shell is glass: replace some of it with Reactor Casing.
Make the room bigger along its short side.

gui.alaindustrial.reactor_controller.too: The reactor stores what the grid does not take. A full buffer does not stop the reaction.
Water cools the reactor: last tick it carried %1$s%% of the heat. Whatever it leaves heats the room while the rods work. Columns in one stack share their water; columns side by side do not.
Rod depth sets the share of power. Less depth means less heat, water and uranium. 0%% stops the reaction.
%1$s%% — the room melts its own contents
Heat the water did not carry away
A reactor without a room has no heat, only instability. Too many racks in one pile run away into an accident.
Energy delivered last tick. When the reactor stands still, the reason is shown instead.
Steam pressure is how much steam the columns hold. It leaves through Steam Pipes to a Steam Nozzle. From 90%% the exhaust is blocked: there is water, but nowhere to boil to.
Pull the rods all the way out: depth 0%%. Cutting the redstone signal with a lever does the same.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.alaindust: Ala Industrial — an EU/FE tech mod for Minecraft (Fabric and NeoForge). Build an industrial power grid with wind, solar and water generators, cables and a Battery Box, run ore through macerators, extractors and an electric furnace, mine four new metals — tin, silver, nickel and uranium — and store it all in the Iron Chest. LV tier ready, MV/HV planned.

blueprint.alaindustrial.energy_basics.st: Burns fuel and produces energy (EU). With nowhere to send it, it stores the energy inside.
Every piece of cable is a small buffer. Energy moves from piece to piece, not instantly.
Takes energy from the cable and smelts without coal.
No cable, no energy. The furnace stops.
blueprint.alaindustrial.solar_storage.st: Produces energy by day under an open sky. It stops at night and in the rain.
Stores energy for the night. It takes energy in on its front face and gives it out from the back.
The box feeds its stored energy to machines, even after the sun has set.
The side faces of the box do not connect. Run cables to its front and back faces.
blueprint.alaindustrial.ore_processing.s: Grinds ore or raw metal into two dusts. One ore gives twice the metal.
Presses dust back into an item. Diamond dust becomes a diamond.
Pulls the useful part out of raw materials. One poppy gives two dyes.
The front face of a machine does not take a cable.
Connect the cable to a side, the back, the top or the bottom.
blueprint.alaindustrial.cable_grades.ste: The cheapest wire. It carries little but loses almost nothing. Bare wire shocks while energy flows.
Copper in a rubber sleeve. It loses less than bare copper and never shocks.
A wide wire for strong lines. It loses the most, so keep it short.
The widest wire and the lowest loss of the bare cables. The price is an expensive craft.
One gold piece in a tin line gives the whole network gold losses. Build a line from one grade.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mv_storage.title: Bigger storage and charging
blueprint.alaindustrial.mv_storage.step1: Holds far more than the Battery Box and is crafted from one.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mv_storage.step2: Copper Cable carries too little for this store. Gold Cable fills it faster.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mv_storage.step3: Stand on the plate and it charges all your gear. Blue light means charging.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mv_storage.step4: Green light: everything is charged. Red means the station has run out of energy.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mv_storage.step5: The side faces of the store do not connect. Run cables to its front and back faces.
blueprint.alaindustrial.smelting.title: Furnaces
blueprint.alaindustrial.smelting.step1.t: Faster than a vanilla furnace and still burns fuel. It needs no energy.
blueprint.alaindustrial.smelting.step2.t: A cable does not connect to the Iron Furnace. Feed it coal or wood instead.
blueprint.alaindustrial.smelting.step3.t: Melts different ingots into one. Copper and tin make bronze, slot order does not matter.
blueprint.alaindustrial.smelting.step4.t: Gold and silver make electrum. An extra item in the third slot blocks a two-part alloy.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lava_power.title: Lava power
blueprint.alaindustrial.lava_power.step1: Burns lava instead of coal and gives more energy. A pump can feed it lava.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lava_power.step2: Turns any food into identical rations that stack together. It needs empty cans.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lava_power.step3: The front face of a generator gives no energy. Connect the cable to any other face.
blueprint.alaindustrial.insulated_cables: Tin in a rubber sheath. It loses less than bare tin and never shocks.
The wide gold line made safe to touch. It also loses less than bare gold.
The lowest loss in the mod, and no shock even on the strongest line.
One bare piece and the whole line loses like bare gold. That piece shocks, too.
Insulate the whole line, then the lower loss works.
blueprint.alaindustrial.solar_tiers.step: Put a Solar Evolution Chip into a Solar Panel. It grows over a few clear days.
Stronger than the Solar Panel, but works only by day under an open sky.
A solid block over the panel stops it. Glass lets the light through.
Grows from a Solar Panel with a Lunar Evolution Chip. Works at night, a little even in rain.
Put a Resonance Chip into the Daylight Solar Panel. The chip is used up.
The strongest day panel, even more at noon. Snow stops it completely.
blueprint.alaindustrial.item_pipes.title: Item pipes
blueprint.alaindustrial.item_pipes.step1: Carries items between chests and machines. It needs no energy.
blueprint.alaindustrial.item_pipes.step2: Both sides are plain, so nothing moves. The pipe does not pass items back and forth.
blueprint.alaindustrial.item_pipes.step3: Set the sides with a Wrench: the orange mouth takes, the teal nozzle puts.
blueprint.alaindustrial.item_pipes.step4: Thicker and faster. Its sides are set with the same Wrench.
blueprint.alaindustrial.item_pipes.step5: One plain pipe in the line, and the whole line moves at its speed.
blueprint.alaindustrial.fluids.title: Pumping fluids
blueprint.alaindustrial.fluids.step1.tex: Pumps fluid from the block at its front face: lava, water and others.
blueprint.alaindustrial.fluids.step2.tex: It spends energy on every bucket it pumps from the world.
blueprint.alaindustrial.fluids.step3.tex: Carries water, lava and other fluids. Its sides are set with a Wrench.
blueprint.alaindustrial.fluids.step4.tex: The pipe takes from the pump and fills the Geothermal Generator.
blueprint.alaindustrial.fluids.step5.tex: The pump only takes from the block at its front face. Here it looks the other way.
blueprint.alaindustrial.wind_and_water.s: Needs a Wooden Rotor and open sky. The higher it stands, the more energy it gives.
Energy leaves only through the back face. Lead the cable from there.
A block above the turbine stops it. It needs open sky over it.
Needs a Water Wheel. The wheel turns one block in front of the mill.
Only flowing or falling water around the wheel counts. Still water gives nothing.
A solid block next to the wheel stops the mill. Keep the space around it free.
blueprint.alaindustrial.event_power.step: Insert a Copper Conductor Tip: it stores the strike. Without a tip the strike is lost.
Lightning hits it in rain and storms. Energy goes out of every side but the top.
Anything above the rod blocks the strike. Deserts and snowy biomes get no rain.
Gives a little energy on every new step. Standing on it gives nothing more.
A plate lying right on a cable or a store is not an output. Put a floor block between.
A cable two blocks below the plate sees it through the floor block and stays hidden.
blueprint.alaindustrial.water_bath.title: Tanks and the bath
blueprint.alaindustrial.water_bath.step1: Holds one fluid and keeps it when broken. Fill it with a bucket or a pipe.
blueprint.alaindustrial.water_bath.step2: Turns fibre and Silver Dust into Flux Thread. It also needs water and energy.
blueprint.alaindustrial.water_bath.step3: Without water the bath stands still, even with energy and materials inside.
blueprint.alaindustrial.water_bath.step4: Holds twice as much and does not burn in lava. It is crafted from the portable tank.
blueprint.alaindustrial.heat.title: Heat
blueprint.alaindustrial.heat.step1.title: Electric Heater
blueprint.alaindustrial.heat.step1.text: Sits under a Vulcanizer and heats it. It must warm up first, cold it gives no heat.
blueprint.alaindustrial.heat.step2.title: Beside, not under
blueprint.alaindustrial.heat.step2.text: Heat goes only to the block right above. A heater beside the machine does nothing.
blueprint.alaindustrial.automation.title: Breaking and assembly
blueprint.alaindustrial.automation.step1: Breaks the block in front with the tool in its slot, the same way a player would.
blueprint.alaindustrial.automation.step2: It takes tools up to the stone tier only. An iron pickaxe does not fit in the slot.
blueprint.alaindustrial.automation.step3: Crafts recipes from an Assembly Blueprint, taking materials from a Storage Module beside it.
blueprint.alaindustrial.automation.step4: The module must touch the assembler with a face. A corner contact is not a link.
blueprint.alaindustrial.rubber_line.step: Turns oil into raw rubber. Pour oil in by pipe or with a bucket in its top slot.
Give it energy by cable on any side but the front. Each run takes a bucket of oil.
Raw rubber and sulfur dust become rubber. It needs energy and heat from right below.
On a plain block it waits. A lit campfire, lava or a warm heater below starts it.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_farm.title: Farm fuel
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_farm.step1.t: Ferments crops with water into biofuel. Biomass comes out only sometimes.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_farm.step2.t: Biofuel leaves only through the bottom face. Put a pipe under the barrel.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_farm.step3.t: A pipe on the side cannot take biofuel out. The sides only take water in.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_farm.step4.t: Sprays nutrient solution on crops around it so they grow faster. Fill it by pipe.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_farm.step5.t: It uses no energy at all, so a cable does not connect. It runs on solution only.
blueprint.alaindustrial.wood_and_waste.s: Saws logs into more planks than a crafting table gives. Five modes for five products.
In its fifth mode a log turns into sawdust, cheap feed for other machines.
Grinds any junk into slag, even valuables. Stone, metal and fuel together give rich slag.
One kind of junk makes poor slag. The lamps on the front count the kinds.
Modules touching by faces join into one store behind one window.
blueprint.alaindustrial.redstone_control: Splits uranium dust in two, a second ore doubling after the Macerator.
With a heater below but no redstone signal, the rotor stands still and uses no energy.
Hold the signal on. The rotor spins up, the heater warms, then the dust is split.
While powered, hostile mobs flee its zone and cannot come close.
Here it is the other way round: a redstone signal switches the field off.
blueprint.alaindustrial.wind_upkeep.step: Grows from a Wind Turbine with a Solar Evolution Chip. Steady output in any weather.
Grows with the Lunar Evolution Chip. Weak in clear weather, strongest in a storm.
Mills facing the same way need one block of air between them, or both stop.
Catches surplus nobody uses and packs it into an energy clot. Cable on top or bottom.
Its sides take no cable. Energy goes in only through the top and the bottom.
Fixes a worn rotor for one plate and energy. Each repair lowers its top durability.
blueprint.alaindustrial.pipe_grades.step: Carries twice as much fluid as the plain pipe. Set its ends with the wrench.
One plain pipe in the line slows all of it to plain speed.
Goes inside a reactor room, after the Reactor Inlet. A working reactor does not melt it.
Inside a working reactor room a plain pipe melts into lava.
blueprint.alaindustrial.chest_tiers.step: A copper chest ringed with iron. One row more than a vanilla chest, contents kept.
Each tier is made from the one before: the chest goes in the middle, ingots around it.
Silver Chest ringed with gold ingots. Another row of slots.
More rows than fit on screen: the window scrolls.
The top tier. TNT and creepers do not break it, but a wither still does.
blueprint.alaindustrial.radiation.title: Radiation
Left where a reactor blew up. The brighter the green, the stronger it glows.
Clicks faster as danger gets closer. It works from any slot.
Water above the soil speeds its decay. In time it turns back into dirt.
Dug soil keeps glowing in a plain chest, as if it lay on the ground.
Iron Chest and shielding plates. Nothing inside it irradiates anyone.
blueprint.alaindustrial.repeller_tiers.s: A full Soul Vessel put into the Small Mob Repeller makes it grow.
It keeps its stored energy, but copper cable can no longer feed it.
On a medium-voltage line the field runs again, over a wider zone.
A vessel with even more souls grows it one step further.
The last step. It needs electrum cable, gold is not enough.
blueprint.alaindustrial.garden.title: Garden
blueprint.alaindustrial.garden.step1.tex: Put it on moist farmland and right-click it with cotton seeds.
blueprint.alaindustrial.garden.step2.tex: No water nearby: growth pauses. The plant waits and does not die.
blueprint.alaindustrial.garden.step3.tex: Right-click a ripe bush for cotton fiber. The bush stays and fruits again.
blueprint.alaindustrial.garden.step4.tex: Give the station a drone, seeds and bone meal. The drone tends the crops nearby.
blueprint.alaindustrial.garden.step5.tex: Without a hoe the drone does not harvest ripe crops.
blueprint.alaindustrial.garden.step6.tex: The drone brings the harvest into the station and plants again.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mutation.title: Mutation
blueprint.alaindustrial.mutation.step1.t: The base of the machine. It needs any glass on top.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mutation.step2.t: Glass on the base becomes the dome. Stained glass tints it.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mutation.step3.t: The chip sets the mode and is not used up. Uranium gives the charge.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mutation.step4.t: On success one item becomes two. On failure the input is lost.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mutation.step5.t: Without a mutation chip the incubator does not start.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tool_kit.title: Tool kit
blueprint.alaindustrial.tool_kit.step1.t: Both pipe sides are plain, so nothing moves between the chests.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tool_kit.step2.t: Right-click a pipe side to change its mode. Only that side changes.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tool_kit.step3.t: Set the other side to put. Now items ride the pipe.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tool_kit.step4.t: Shift and right-click takes a mod block apart. Energy and items stay in it.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tool_kit.step5.t: Right-click a cable: supply and demand of its network. Here the line is broken.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tool_kit.step6.t: Close the gap and the analyzer shows energy reaching the furnace.
blueprint.alaindustrial.power_tools.step: Mines stone and ore fast. Uses energy, not durability.
Cuts logs and leaves in one stroke.
A station with no cable stays red. The tools stay empty.
Feed the station from a generator. It charges all four.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lights.title: Lights
blueprint.alaindustrial.lights.step1.tex: Bright light on any face of a block.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lights.step2.tex: The lamp stays in place when the block under it is gone.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lights.step3.tex: A torch and uranium dust make a torch that never goes out.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lights.step4.tex: An ordinary torch next to water drops as an item.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lights.step5.tex: The uranium torch keeps burning with water all around.
blueprint.alaindustrial.kok_sagyz_farm.s: Plant kok-sagyz seeds on dirt or grass.
A ripe flower grows a root two blocks down.
Dig the lowest root block. The flower keeps growing.
A root gives raw rubber and inulin.
Without the flower the root stops growing.
blueprint.alaindustrial.reactor_room.ste: The heart of the room. It checks the walls around it.
A closed shell of casing with a window of reactor glass.
Ordinary glass breaks the shell. The room does not form.
Energy leaves the room through the outlet.
The reactor lever starts the reaction.
With the lever down nothing runs.
blueprint.alaindustrial.steam_exhaust.st: Lets steam out of the line into the air.
Water goes in, steam rises up the pipe to the nozzle.
A fluid pipe does not carry steam.
Inside use the reinforced steam pipe.
A plain steam pipe inside the room melts.
A block over the nozzle stops the steam.
blueprint.alaindustrial.teleporter.title: Teleporter
blueprint.alaindustrial.teleporter.step1: The station stores energy for jumps. Place it at your base.
blueprint.alaindustrial.teleporter.step2: One glass block is not enough. Without a capsule you cannot jump here.
blueprint.alaindustrial.teleporter.step3: Two glass blocks on top make a capsule. You land inside it.
blueprint.alaindustrial.teleporter.step4: The door side takes no energy. A cable there does not connect.
blueprint.alaindustrial.teleporter.step5: Power any other side. The station charges slowly, over minutes.
blueprint.alaindustrial.teleporter.step6: Shift and right-click each station with the remote. Then pick one and jump.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mob_wheel.title: Mob Wheel
It goes in the back corner. It holds the logic and the energy socket.
Eleven posts fill the four corner columns, three blocks high.
The wheel goes in the very middle of the cube.
The gate goes in the middle of the front. One post is missing, so nothing assembles.
All 14 blocks in place: the wheel assembles. Lead a mob in and close the gate.
Energy leaves the drive at its side and back. Hay nearby helps the runner rest faster.
blueprint.alaindustrial.oil_refining.ste: You craft one segment. On its own it does nothing.
Two segments are not a tower yet.
Three segments make a tower: diesel on top, oil in the middle, fuel oil below.
Only the base takes energy. A cable at the middle does not connect.
A pump feeds oil into the middle. Power the base and it makes diesel and fuel oil.
Put it on top: less oil is lost and you get more diesel.
blueprint.alaindustrial.crystal_farm.ste: It sits in a wall with its panel outside. The room lies behind it.
One block is missing. The room is not sealed, so nothing will grow.
Decking, glazing and a door close the room. Once sealed, the seams disappear.
Place it inside and feed it amethyst shards.
Real amethyst clusters grow on the bed. Energy is optional and only speeds them up.
Outside a sealed room a seedbed takes shards but grows nothing.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mirror_concentra: Grown from the daylight panel. It works alone as one block.
Seven sections around it build the machine at full size, two by two by two.
One section is missing, so nothing assembles yet.
The seventh section assembles the machine on its own. Its output stays the same.
The upper tier takes no cable. No energy flows.
Connect a cable to any side of the four bottom cells.
blueprint.alaindustrial.monitoring.title: Monitoring Wall
blueprint.alaindustrial.monitoring.step1: The heart of the wall. It takes power by cable and holds the capacity cards.
blueprint.alaindustrial.monitoring.step2: The front face takes no energy. The cable gets no arm and the core stays dark.
blueprint.alaindustrial.monitoring.step3: Any other face takes energy. The core lights up while it has charge.
blueprint.alaindustrial.monitoring.step4: Without a card the wall shows nothing. Each card lets it track a few more kinds of items.
blueprint.alaindustrial.monitoring.step5: Run it from the core to your chests. It reads what is inside and carries nothing.
blueprint.alaindustrial.monitoring.step6: Panels touching the core or each other join the wall. Right-click one with an item to show its count.
blueprint.alaindustrial.upgrade_table.st: One craft gives two casings. A single casing does nothing on its own.
Casings next to each other stay casings. They join only one on top of the other.
Stack one casing on the other and they become the table.
The front face takes no energy. Feed the lower half from a side or the back.
Put in the drill and the module. The table uses energy and fits the upgrade onto the same drill.
The drill now also takes the block above and below. Press L to switch the mode.
blueprint.alaindustrial.workstation.step: One craft gives two casings. A single casing is a plain block.
Stack the second casing on the first. The pair becomes a computer.
Only the lower half takes energy. A cable to the upper half gives nothing.
Feed the lower half from a side or the back. The screens light up while it has charge.
Open it to learn skills for Ala-Fragments. Each skill also takes a large charge of energy.
blueprint.alaindustrial.industrial_workb: Built around a crafting table with tin and wooden gears. It is also the Industrialist's job site.
A normal 3x3 grid. Next time it shows the last recipe as faint hints.
A broken workbench forgets its last recipe.
Every workbench remembers its own last craft, for all players.
blueprint.alaindustrial.reactor_core.ste: Right-click with fuel rods, the rack holds four. Fuel and water levels show on the model.
All fuelled rods wear down together. An empty hand takes the spent cladding out first.
A pipe in the wall is a hole, so the room does not form.
The inlet passes fluid through a sealed wall. Water goes in and the room forms.
The lamp is a piece of wall. It lights the room inside once the room has formed.
The Reactor Airlock Door opens only on a redstone pulse and shuts by itself. The button gives the pulse.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mod_ores.title: Mod Ores
blueprint.alaindustrial.mod_ores.step1.t: Tin, silver and nickel lie in stone and deepslate. A stone pickaxe or better mines them.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mod_ores.step2.t: Uranium ore needs an iron pickaxe or better. A stone one breaks it and nothing drops.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mod_ores.step3.t: An iron pickaxe gets raw uranium. Sulfur ore gives raw sulfur to a stone pickaxe.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mod_ores.step4.t: Found in the Nether among netherrack, basalt and blackstone. Needs a diamond pickaxe.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mod_ores.step5.t: Crushes one raw ore into two dusts. That is twice the ingots from every ore.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mod_ores.step6.t: Smelts each dust into an ingot. Uranium and palladium dust melt only here.
Clear glass in a tempered iron frame. Made from glass and tempered iron plates.
A creeper or TNT blast breaks ordinary glass. The window is left as a hole.
Holds a creeper or TNT blast. It drops itself, no Silk Touch needed.
Join to neighbouring bars, glass panes and walls, like iron bars.
Goes along any axis and holds a lantern, like a vanilla chain.
The ladder climbs like a wooden one and does not burn. The trapdoor opens by hand or redstone.
blueprint.alaindustrial.rotors_and_wheel: Goes into the turbine slot. It wears out only while the turbine makes energy.
Crafted from the wooden rotor. Same slot, more energy, lasts much longer.
Crafted from the reinforced rotor. The most energy and the longest life.
A worn rotor breaks. With an empty slot the turbine makes nothing.
The water mill wheel has the same three grades. Each one is crafted from the one before.
A better wheel goes into the same slot. A wide channel shows the gain best.
blueprint.alaindustrial.lightning_tips.s: The tip goes into the rod and stores a strike. The mast shows a tip is in.
The store stays full. The next strike is lost and the tip wears twice as fast.
A cable empties the store into the network. Then each strike is caught.
Crafted from the copper tip. It stores more and gives energy faster.
Crafted from the reinforced tip. The largest store and the fastest output.
blueprint.alaindustrial.machine_chips.st: Goes into the upgrade panel. The machine works faster and draws twice the energy per tick.
Crafted from the chip before. Only one overclocker works in a machine.
Tier III draws more than copper cable carries. The machine starves.
Gold cable feeds tier III in full. The machine runs fast again.
Silences the machine fully. Speed, energy and output stay the same.
Craft the blank from diamond dust, redstone and tempered iron.
An empty store cannot charge anything. The blank stays a blank.
Charge the blank in a charge slot. Once full, it turns into the crystal.
Its blank is built around a finished energy crystal and charged the same way.
The incubator with a Creation Chip turns an amethyst shard into a resonant shard.
Shards and a lapotron crystal make the last blank. Charge it for the top crystal.
blueprint.alaindustrial.batteries.title: Batteries
Craft it from tin, redstone and copper cable. It holds a small charge.
The cable meets the box's output face. The battery stays empty.
Feed the box through its input face. Its charge slot fills the battery.
Three batteries, leather and a circuit make the pack. Their charge goes into it.
The box charges the pack and the pouch too. A worn pack keeps the pouch topped up.
A charged battery in the discharge slot sends its energy back into the line.
blueprint.alaindustrial.jetpack.title: Jetpack
blueprint.alaindustrial.jetpack.step1.te: Built around an energy pack and two batteries. Their charge goes into it.
blueprint.alaindustrial.jetpack.step2.te: A station with no cable stays red. The jetpack stays empty.
blueprint.alaindustrial.jetpack.step3.te: Stand on a fed station with the jetpack on. It charges while you wait.
blueprint.alaindustrial.jetpack.step4.te: Wear it on the chest and hold jump in the air. It spends energy only while it pushes.
blueprint.alaindustrial.jetpack.step5.te: Out of charge mid-flight? Keep holding jump to glide down without damage.
blueprint.alaindustrial.electric_weapons: A bow with two batteries, coils and a circuit. Arrows still come from your inventory.
Built around a diamond sword. Charged, it hits harder and reaches further.
Both run on energy instead of durability. Charge them in the box.
With no charge the arrow drops a block in front of you.
Charged, the bow draws faster and the arrow flies far and straight.
blueprint.alaindustrial.drill_tips.title: Tool upgrades
blueprint.alaindustrial.drill_tips.step1: The electric drill with diamond dust, invar and a silver gear. Its charge carries over.
blueprint.alaindustrial.drill_tips.step2: Shift and right-click toggles Silk Touch. Ore then drops as ore.
blueprint.alaindustrial.drill_tips.step3: The tipped chainsaw and shovel toggle it too: leaves and grass blocks drop whole.
blueprint.alaindustrial.drill_tips.step4: A plain hoe makes dry farmland. Far from water it turns back to dirt.
blueprint.alaindustrial.drill_tips.step5: The tipped hoe makes the farmland wet at once. It is a head start, not a sprinkler.
blueprint.alaindustrial.drill_tips.step6: Make the head on a table. The smithing table fits it, using the template from bastions.
blueprint.alaindustrial.scythes.title: Scythes
blueprint.alaindustrial.scythes.step1.te: Right-click mows grass, flowers and leaves in an area. Each drops what it would by hand.
blueprint.alaindustrial.scythes.step2.te: One swing clears the patch. Crops are never cut in this mode.
blueprint.alaindustrial.scythes.step3.te: A plain right-click leaves the field alone. The ripe wheat stays standing.
blueprint.alaindustrial.scythes.step4.te: Shift and right-click take only ripe crops, sometimes with an extra seed. Young ones grow on.
blueprint.alaindustrial.scythes.step5.te: Each tier cuts a wider area. Netherite is the widest and does not burn.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tempered_iron_ge: Smelt an iron ingot in a furnace or blast furnace to get tempered iron.
The electric furnace tempers iron on energy instead of fuel.
The tools dig and fight like iron ones, a little faster, and they last longer.
Like iron, the Tempered Iron Pickaxe gets nothing from diamond ore or obsidian.
Diamond ore and obsidian need a diamond pickaxe.
Tools and armor are mended at an anvil with tempered iron.
blueprint.alaindustrial.protective_suits: A leather armor piece plus a slime ball makes an insulated piece.
Each insulated piece takes part of the shock from a bare cable. The full set takes all of it.
Slime stops current, not radiation. The insulated set gives no shield here.
The shielding suit cuts the radiation dose and wears out while it does. Leave in time.
Charge it in a Battery Box. Uranium carried inside it irradiates no one.
The fluxweave suit charges here too. While charged it adds breathing, speed and softer falls.
blueprint.alaindustrial.electromagnets.s: Craft it from a copper coil, a circuit, iron, lapis and redstone.
A Battery Box with nothing feeding it charges nothing. The magnet stays empty.
Fed by a generator, it charges the magnet. Charged, it pulls nearby drops to you from any slot.
A circuit, iron and redstone make a Blank Module. With paper it becomes a Magnet Filter Module.
Built around the first magnet. It reaches farther and also pulls experience.
blueprint.alaindustrial.forge_hammer.ste: Craft it from iron ingots and a stick.
Hammer and ingot on a crafting table give a plate. The hammer stays and loses a little durability.
Copper, gold, tin and the other mod metals hammer into plates the same way.
A Compressor with no cable stays dark. The ingot is not pressed.
With power it presses plates without wearing out a hammer.
blueprint.alaindustrial.alloys.title: Alloys
blueprint.alaindustrial.alloys.step1.tex: The generator burns, but no cable reaches the smelter. The ingots sit and nothing melts.
blueprint.alaindustrial.alloys.step2.tex: Lay the cable. Two iron ingots and one nickel ingot melt into invar.
blueprint.alaindustrial.alloys.step3.tex: Three copper ingots and one tin ingot give two bronze ingots.
blueprint.alaindustrial.alloys.step4.tex: Copper with nickel gives cupronickel. Gold with silver gives electrum.
blueprint.alaindustrial.alloys.step5.tex: One netherite ingot and two electrum ingots give two netherite alloy ingots.
blueprint.alaindustrial.alloys.step6.tex: One palladium ingot and three tempered iron give three shielding alloy ingots.
blueprint.alaindustrial.metal_decor.step: Nine bronze ingots fit into one block. It keeps the metal in a single slot.
A block turns back into nine ingots with no loss. Every mod ingot has its own block.
The stonecutter cuts a block into stairs, a slab or a wall. A crafting table works too.
A stone pickaxe breaks a block of electrum, but nothing drops.
Electrum, silver and palladium need an iron pickaxe. Bronze, invar and nickel take stone.
Walls join each other like stone walls. Stairs and slabs make roofs and steps.
blueprint.alaindustrial.dusts.title: Dusts
blueprint.alaindustrial.dusts.step1.text: Raw ore goes in, two dusts come out. That doubles every ore you mine.
blueprint.alaindustrial.dusts.step2.text: Dust smelts back into an ingot. Raw gold becomes two gold ingots.
blueprint.alaindustrial.dusts.step3.text: A plain furnace does not smelt palladium dust. It stays dark and the coal is not burned.
blueprint.alaindustrial.dusts.step4.text: The electric furnace smelts any metal dust, palladium and silver included.
blueprint.alaindustrial.dusts.step5.text: Coal and diamond dust are not smelted. The compressor presses them back into coal and diamonds.
blueprint.alaindustrial.dusts.step6.text: Lapis ore gives six dusts at once. The compressor turns each back into lapis.
blueprint.alaindustrial.reinforced_plate: The hammer beats an ingot into a plate. Two plates make one reinforced plate.
The macerator does not take an alloy ingot. Alloys have no dust, so it stays dark.
The compressor presses an ingot into a plate and two plates into a reinforced one.
Invar, cupronickel and tempered iron press into plates the same way.
Palladium and shielding alloy ingots make plates too. Shielding plates build the reactor room.
Only the hammer makes it: two shielding plates and depleted uranium.
blueprint.alaindustrial.gears_and_bearin: Four sticks around a wooden button make a wooden gear. Every other gear starts from it.
Four cobblestone or four iron ingots around a wooden gear give a stone or iron gear.
Gold, silver and electrum ingots around a wooden gear give the higher gears.
A stone gear in nickel plates gives basic bearings. Add an electrum gear for a reinforced one.
The recycler has power but no blades. It does not run.
Iron blades are built around a basic bearing and an iron gear. With them it runs.
blueprint.alaindustrial.circuits.title: Circuits and Casings
blueprint.alaindustrial.circuits.step1.t: Silver, nickel, quartz and an emerald on a crafting table. Nearly every LV machine needs one.
blueprint.alaindustrial.circuits.step2.t: Eight iron plates make a casing. It is the body every LV machine is built on.
blueprint.alaindustrial.circuits.step3.t: A casing is not a machine yet. It takes no energy and does nothing with ore.
blueprint.alaindustrial.circuits.step4.t: Casing, flint and a circuit make a macerator. The same spot now grinds ore into dust.
blueprint.alaindustrial.circuits.step5.t: Gold and rubber make the circuit advanced. Two of them and tempered iron make the MV casing.
blueprint.alaindustrial.circuits.step6.t: Advanced circuit, resonance coil and palladium plates. It goes into the reactor controller.
blueprint.alaindustrial.coils_and_chokes: Copper cable wound on tin makes a coil. With a spatial crystal and shards it becomes a resonance coil.
Invar plates, two copper coils and a circuit make a choke.
Each tier sits in the middle of the next. Diamond dust makes it reinforced, resonance coils advanced.
A plain solar panel does not take the resonance chip. It comes straight back.
Put the chip into a daylight panel and let it work through a few clear days.
The panel grows into the concentrator. Stored energy carries over, the chip is used up.
blueprint.alaindustrial.fluxweave_line.s: Breaking grass sometimes drops cotton seeds.
Place a trellis on wet farmland and plant the seeds. Cotton climbs it slowly.
Right click the ripe bush for fiber. The bush stays and fruits again.
Water alone is not enough. With no cable to the generator the bath stays dark.
Fiber and silver dust in the powered bath come out as flux thread.
Four threads make a cloth. Cloth goes into the EU armor and repairs it too.
blueprint.alaindustrial.carbon_line.step: The compressor presses sixteen coal dust into one carbon rod.
Two rods and the forge hammer on a crafting table make a double rod.
The alloy smelter fires double rods with slag into a briquette. The compressor makes one from soot.
The piston must face the water. Turned away, it fires and the briquette just floats.
Fired into the water, the piston splits the briquette with redstone dust into ceramic plates.
Four plates make a block. It resists blasts like reactor casing and splits back into plates.
blueprint.alaindustrial.byproducts.title: Machine Byproducts
blueprint.alaindustrial.byproducts.step1: Without blades the recycler stands still, even with power. The junk just sits there.
blueprint.alaindustrial.byproducts.step2: With blades it grinds anything. One kind of junk gives poor slag, and ash piles up too.
blueprint.alaindustrial.byproducts.step3: The sawmill in sawdust mode feeds the recycler. Two kinds of junk light two lamps and give slag.
blueprint.alaindustrial.byproducts.step4: Stone, metal and fuel in even shares light all three lamps. That mix gives rich slag.
blueprint.alaindustrial.byproducts.step5: A furnace tempers iron blades. Diamonds around tempered ones make the fastest blades.
blueprint.alaindustrial.byproducts.step6: Nine poor slag make a block of slag. Two ash make gray dye.
blueprint.alaindustrial.uranium_fuel.ste: Raw Uranium grinds into two Uranium Dust. The Electric Furnace smelts the dust into an ingot.
On a hot heater, with a lever held on, it splits Uranium Dust into two Uranium Concentrate.
The same centrifuge splits a Uranium Ingot into two Depleted Uranium.
The cable does not reach the Compressor. The concentrate goes in, but nothing comes out.
With power it presses two Uranium Concentrate into one Enriched Uranium (U-235).
Fuel Rod Cladding and Enriched Uranium on a crafting table make a Fuel Rod for the reactor.
blueprint.alaindustrial.radiation_produc: A Creation Chip and a Uranium Ingot arm the Incubator. A diamond can become an Irradiated Diamond.
With the same chip, lapis lazuli can become Mutagen Dust.
A spent ingot leaves Depleted Uranium. Put it back in to try for an Unstable Isotope.
Many tries fail and the item is lost. Sometimes Irradiated Slag drops instead.
Without the glass dome the Incubator does not start, even with power.
Put any glass on the base. It becomes the dome and the machine can work.
blueprint.alaindustrial.mutation_chips.s: Glass, Copper Coils and an Electronic Circuit make an Empty Chip.
An Empty Chip with amethyst and a Uranium Plate becomes a Duplication Chip.
With this chip the Incubator can turn one iron ingot into two. The chip is not used up.
This chip swaps an item for an equal one: sand turns into red sand.
A Creation Chip has no recipe for iron. The ingot does not go in and the machine stays dark.
It makes new materials of the mod: amethyst can become a Resonant Shard.
blueprint.alaindustrial.canned_goods.ste: Tin Plates and a glass pane make eight Empty Cans.
The front of the Canning Machine takes no energy. A cable there leaves it dark.
Cable on the side: food and Empty Cans go in, Canned Rations come out. All rations stack.
Click the Pump with an empty Vacuum Capsule to take one bucket of its fluid.
Empty a lava capsule into the Geothermal Generator. It burns the lava, the capsule comes back.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_fluids.title: Bio fluids
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_fluids.step1: Crops and water become a Biofuel Bucket. Sometimes Biomass drops too.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_fluids.step2: Biofuel goes into the middle of the tower, but with no cable the column stays dark.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_fluids.step3: With power it distils biofuel into nutrient solution at the top.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_fluids.step4: The Sprinkler takes only nutrient solution. Biofuel does not go in and the field does not grow.
blueprint.alaindustrial.bio_fluids.step5: A Nutrient Solution Bucket fills it. It sprays the crops around and they grow faster.
blueprint.alaindustrial.liquid_fuels.ste: Scoop an oil pool with an empty bucket. A pool never refills.
Fire next to oil sets the whole pool burning, cell after cell.
Lava does not light oil. Only fire does, so keep flames away.
The Distillation Column does nothing without energy at its base.
Oil goes into the middle. Diesel comes out at the top, fuel oil at the base.
Pour fuel oil into the middle again and the tower turns it into diesel.
Put the Solar Evolution Chip into the panel and let it work in the sun.
A block over the panel stops it working, so it does not grow.
Under open sky the panel grows into a Daylight Solar Panel. Its charge stays.
The Lunar Evolution Chip grows the panel through the nights.
It becomes a Moonlit Solar Panel that works only at night.
The same chips grow a Wind Turbine into a Sky Mill or a Tempest Mill.
A plaque on the wall of an abandoned lab. Its first letter is broken off.
Plates show the digits 0 to 9. There is no recipe, only labs have them.
Without a pickaxe a plate breaks and drops nothing.
Any pickaxe takes the plate away whole.
A placed plate turns its face to you. Build numbers into your walls.
blueprint.alaindustrial.random_jump.step: Amethyst shards, an ender pearl and glowstone dust make a Spatial Crystal.
The crystal goes into a Resonance Coil, and coils make the chip.
Shift and right click the station with the chip. Turquoise corners light up.
A random jump works only in the Overworld. Here the station refuses.
In the Overworld pick Random on the remote and the station throws you far away.
blueprint.alaindustrial.test_source.step: An endless source for testing builds. It comes only from creative mode.
Run a cable to a machine and it works without any fuel.
A source switched off in its screen gives nothing, and the furnace stops.
Click a cable with the breaker. It goes on closed, so the line keeps running.
Click it with an empty hand to open it. The line past it goes dead.
Close it again and the furnace runs. The source's slot charges a drill.
Paper around a pinch of lapis dust makes blank sheets. A blank sheet stores nothing yet.
Lay the recipe out in the ghost grid and record it onto the blank. The machine then crafts by itself.
With the generator and cable gone the assembler does not run. The material waits in the module.
Power is back, and the module feeds the machine from any face it touches. The sticks come out.
The recorded sheet comes out whole. Keep it in a chest or move it to another assembler.
blueprint.alaindustrial.stats_chip.title: Machine Statistics
blueprint.alaindustrial.stats_chip.step1: A copper coil, two glass panes, an empty chip and redstone make the measuring chip.
blueprint.alaindustrial.stats_chip.step2: With no cable the furnace stays dark. The chip is in place, but there is no work to count.
blueprint.alaindustrial.stats_chip.step3: In a machine the chip goes into the right slot of the upgrade panel. The count starts at once.
blueprint.alaindustrial.stats_chip.step4: A tab in the machine screen opens the panel: working time, energy and items processed.
blueprint.alaindustrial.column_drill.ste: Reinforced invar plates around two chokes make a hollow barrel. It is a part, not a tool.
Two barrels and the parts around them make the module. In the hand it does nothing.
With no cable the upgrade table stays dark. The module and the drill wait inside.
The powered table takes the module and fits the upgrade onto the drill. The same drill returns.
Aim at the middle block: one pass takes it and its neighbours. Each extra block costs energy.
blueprint.alaindustrial.rubber_materials: Grinds raw sulfur or sulfur ore into two sulfur dust. The line runs on energy.
Two roots give one raw rubber and inulin, a by-product the machine spits out.
On plain stone the Vulcanizer stays dark. Raw rubber and sulfur wait inside.
A heater right below gives the strongest heat: one batch leaves three rubber.
A second source of raw rubber: a bucket of oil turns into one raw rubber.
blueprint.alaindustrial.monitor_parts.st: It runs on energy alone. With no cable it stays dark and nothing comes out.
Four amethyst shards and silver dust melt into one reinforced amethyst.
Silver plates, redstone, one reinforced amethyst and a circuit craft the card.
Amethyst at the corners, plates and circuits around an energy crystal.
Panels touching the core join into one wall. The core takes power by cable at its side.
blueprint.alaindustrial.energy_clots.ste: The mills' surplus freezes in the condenser. The longer it fills, the higher the tier.
Wait longer and the same slot gives a higher clot. Taking it early burns the extra.
The bank keeps growing. The third clot asks for the longest wait of the three.
A clot holds no energy and powers nothing. It is a material, not a battery.
Clots go mainly into chips, each built on the one before. Tiers II and III also make crystals.
blueprint.alaindustrial.wind_gauge.title: Wind Gauge
blueprint.alaindustrial.wind_gauge.step1: Two sticks, a glass pane, two tin ingots and two wooden gears on a crafting table.
blueprint.alaindustrial.wind_gauge.step2: Shift and right-click shows the wind where you stand. Down here it is calm, so the mill gives nothing.
blueprint.alaindustrial.wind_gauge.step3: Wind grows with height and is strongest just below the clouds. Measure first, then build the tower.
blueprint.alaindustrial.wind_gauge.step4: Leaves over the mill close the sky. The wind dies even at this height.
blueprint.alaindustrial.garden_drone.ste: Copper and iron ingots, a circuit and a hopper on a crafting table.
Seeds and bone meal sit in the station, but with no drone it does no field work.
Put a drone into the station. It runs on energy and tends the wheat until it ripens.
The drone borrows the station's iron hoe for its field work. Keep one in the slot.
blueprint.alaindustrial.soul_vessel.step: Silver plates, glass, soul sand and a circuit. It fills with souls of hostile mobs you kill yourself.
Any vessel fits the repeller's slot, even an empty one. The line under it shows how many souls are missing.
A full vessel goes into the repeller and is spent. The block grows one tier.
The repeller grew a tier and runs again on a gold line.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tin_line.title: Tin Line
blueprint.alaindustrial.tin_line.step1.t: The macerator turns raw tin into dust. It works on energy from a cable.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tin_line.step2.t: A generator and a cable power the macerator. One raw tin gives two tin dust.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tin_line.step3.t: The iron furnace smelts tin dust into ingots on coal. The electric furnace does the same on power.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tin_line.step4.t: The press does not grind ore. Crush the raw tin first, then press the ingot.
blueprint.alaindustrial.tin_line.step5.t: Fed by the same line, the compressor presses a tin ingot into a plate. A hammer does it by hand.
blueprint.alaindustrial.noble_metals.ste: Raw silver crushes into two silver dust. Nickel and palladium grind the same way.
Silver and nickel dust smelt into ingots in the electric furnace.
The iron furnace does not melt palladium dust. It never lights up for it.
The electric furnace melts any metal dust, palladium included, into an ingot.
blueprint.alaindustrial.deepslate_ores.s: Five of the ores also sit in deepslate, deeper down. They drop the same raw items.
Tin, silver, nickel and sulfur ore give their raw items to a stone pickaxe.
Uranium ore is too hard for a stone pickaxe. The block breaks and nothing drops.
An iron pickaxe gets raw uranium. Its ingot presses into a uranium plate.
The compressor presses a uranium ingot into a plate on energy from the line.
blueprint.alaindustrial.welded_plates.st: Hammer and two cupronickel plates at a crafting table give one reinforced plate.
Invar plates weld the same way. The hammer comes back a little worn.
One plate and the hammer make nothing. Two plates go into one reinforced plate.
Reinforced invar plates and chokes build a core barrel. The drill will need it.
blueprint.alaindustrial.gem_dusts.title: Gem Dusts
Emerald ore crushes into two dusts, the same doubling as metal ores.
Gem dust does not melt in any furnace. The powered electric one stays dark too.
The compressor presses emerald dust back into an emerald.
A whole emerald also goes into the macerator and gives a single dust.
blueprint.alaindustrial.reactor_shell.st: One machine casing with tempered iron plates and shielding plates crafts eight casing blocks.
A sealed box of casing, 5x5x5 at least and up to 14x14x14 by default. Any hole in a wall is a breach.
Without one casing cell the controller refuses the room. Fill the hole to seal it.
With every shell cell in place the controller accepts the room, and the whole shell forms.
blueprint.alaindustrial.door_drive.title: Airlock Door and Drive
blueprint.alaindustrial.door_drive.step1: The drive is crafted from shielding plates, iron ingots, a circuit, tempered iron plates and a piston.
blueprint.alaindustrial.door_drive.step2: The drive goes into the door craft with plates, glass, cable and an iron door.
blueprint.alaindustrial.door_drive.step3: Two door halves stand one above the other at the inner floor level. Only a pulse opens them.
blueprint.alaindustrial.door_drive.step4: Door halves lying flat in the floor do not make a doorway. The room stays unformed.
blueprint.alaindustrial.chest_boats.step: A plain boat and an iron chest on the crafting table. It sails like a vanilla chest boat and holds more.
A bigger chest means a bigger hold. The diamond chest boat carries far more stock.
Bamboo builds a raft the same way: a bamboo raft takes any mod chest.
A vanilla chest boat cannot be upgraded. Craft the boat from a plain boat and the chest.
The shielding chest boat keeps its cargo from radiating: radioactive items inside stay silent.
blueprint.alaindustrial.storage_blocks.s: Nine tin ingots make one block at a crafting table. Every metal of the mod packs the same way.
Back into nine ingots with nothing lost. A block holds nine ingots, so a chest holds nine times more.
Storage blocks of the mod's metals in a row. Any of them also works as a beacon base.
The uranium block radiates wherever it stands, even in a plain chest. A Geiger counter nearby clicks.
Inside the shielding chest the uranium block stays silent: its radiation does not leak out.
blueprint.alaindustrial.decor_forms.step: Six blocks of tin cut into four stairs on the crafting table.
Three blocks of tin in a row make six slabs.
Six blocks of tin in two rows make six walls.
A stonecutter turns one block into stairs, a wall or two slabs. The fence is crafted from tempered iron.
One tin stairs piece in the 3x3 base and the beacon stays dark. Cut forms do not count.
A full 3x3 base of storage blocks lights the beacon. The metals may be mixed.
blueprint.alaindustrial.plate_cladding.s: Four silver plates make one plating block on the crafting table.
The plating unpacks into four plates again, with nothing lost.
Plating blocks tile a wall in two metals: silver and tempered iron.
Tempered iron plates work the same way: four make one block.
tooltip.alaindustrial.sound_absorber.exe: Music, UI and voices stay audible.
So do the reactor siren and Geiger counter.
